image_description: A close-up, eye-level shot of a small weasel (likely a stoat or short-tailed weasel in summer coat) peeking through tall green grass. The animal has reddish-brown fur on its head and back, transitioning to white/cream on its chest and neck. Its eyes are dark and glossy, ears are small and rounded, and the snout is pointed. The foreground grass is slightly out of focus, creating depth.

Both eyes are visible, appearing small relative to the head size and dark/black in color, consistent with the taxonomy.
The ears are visible on top of the head, appearing short and rounded rather than pointed or elongated.

The legs are completely obscured by the tall grass and the animal's body position. No limbs are visible.

The background grass exhibits a slight 'smearing' or painterly quality rather than optical bokeh, typical of AI generation struggling with complex repetitive textures in defocus areas.
